I've had many Bosch dishwashers over the decades - When it came time to upgade my old model after 10 years of hard use I really came up on the dilemma of 300, 500 or 800? Ultimately went with the 800 for various reasons, and here's what it's been like living with them for 6 months: Catalyst drying - yes this really works, with no noticable uptick in electricity consumption. Things are drier, and plastics are not melting. The trick upper rack - the ability to drop own one side of the utensil/cutlery top rack lets me fit in bulkier cooking utensils, spatulas, etc. saving space on the the secnd rack where I used to throw them. Our second rack (cups, glasses) has always been the most overloaded and this helps. Zonal cleaning on the mowest rack - the main impeller is truely different on the 800. The lower models do with a water propelled spinner, whils this is geared and electrically controlled. I've cleaned the worst baked on dishes and it's pretty incredible. I have minor clean-up with a kevlar scrubber to be perfect but the hard work is done. being able to designate the front zone etc. for heaviest cleaning with the extra tri-spray spinner focused on a zone is immensely better. Minor things - the app is good but we don't really use it other than to adjust the amount of crystal-dry fluid. The front panel does everything once you puzzle out the miriad icons and lights. The 800 is noticably quieter than my old model which was already quiet. I summary - The 800 is a significant step up in cost and featires from the 300 model but overall unless your budget is really tight it's worth the upgrade.

Sentence (English): I had a lot of worries.
Comments (English): [ I was really worried. I don't cook at home as I live in a two-person household. Usually, there are a lot of delivery orders so there aren't many dishes to wash, but I had dinner late at work and was going to go to work the next day, so I had to wash the plates, pots, cups, spoons, etc. ] || ---------------- || I had a lot of worries. I live in a two-person household and don't cook at home. Usually, I get a lot of delivery food, so there aren't many dishes to wash. But after a late dinner and heading back to work the next day, I was so tired from washing dishes that I had to deal with just a few plates, pots, cups, spoons, and saucepans. I hate letting things pile up, so I just had to eat and clean up, and it was always 12 or 1 by the time I finished. I searched and agonized a lot. Should I use this? Do I need it? Wouldn't it be nice to have it? Since it's a lease, drilling holes was out of the question, and the mini size made me even more hesitant. I kept it in my head until one tiring day, after washing dishes, I lay down and searched for a dishwasher. It was delivered the next day, and even a woman could install it. I was a little cautious because of the weight, but it took less than 20 minutes from installation to operation. It was a little noisier than I expected, but it's about the same size as the sound of rain or a washing machine, so it's not a big deal. I was worried because it's small, but it holds more than I thought. Of course, it depends on your Tetris skills. I also like that the water supply is next to the sink, so I can get water directly from the faucet. I tried it right away. It's great for cleaning, and the auto-open feature with the hot air fan helps dry the dishes. Sentence (English): One of the first appliances I bought when I moved was an LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I invited an aunt. ] || ---------------- || One of the first appliances I bought when I moved was an LG dishwasher. At first, I thought, "Why bother buying a machine when you only wash dishes so often?" But now, I truly feel it's changed my quality of life. I highly recommend it! The technician came on the appointed date and even took care of the sink replacement. They were incredibly quick and courteous. From installation to user manuals, I was completely satisfied! Reviews: 1. Cleaning power: I was shocked when I first used it. Even greasy frying pans came out clean. Dishes were a given, and pots and cutting boards were just a simple shake. 2. Drying power: It's not just cleaning, but the drying function is truly amazing. After washing, everything was completely dry. Even plastic containers dried better than I expected. Of course, thick or deep containers weren't completely fluffy, but regular dishes, glasses, and lunch boxes were practically dry, so there was no need for a towel. 3. Noise: I was a little worried at first, but it's incredibly quiet. You can't even tell it's running. There is a little noise when the water sprays, but it doesn't interfere with watching TV or talking at all. In fact, it's quieter than an air purifier.

Comments (English): [ I think I made a good purchase. ] || ---------------- || With three kids and my mother, a family of six eats breakfast every morning. Washing dishes isn't a big deal for me; even rinsing them in the dishwasher and putting them in felt like a chore. However, when I replaced the kitchen sink, I ended up buying one because friends highly recommended it, telling me it was a whole new world of convenience. It was a bit inconvenient at first, but now that I've gotten used to it, it's actually quite comfortable. I haven't quite felt that "Wow, this is a whole new world!" moment yet, but the grease from eating pork belly yesterday came off squeaky clean much better than when I washed them by hand. I really love the advantage of the grease not sticking to the scouring pad.

The main water hookup is on the backside of the dishwasher. If it was in the middle of the underside it would be better. The current design allows the water inlet to have stress against it when pushed into the space. If it was designed to be in the middle underside there would be no stress issue and no leak concerns and I wouldn't have ruined hardwood floors. Otherwise it seems to do the job it was bought for.

Sentence (English): I am extremely concerned about the safety and reliability of the GE GDT650SYV0FS dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Serious Safety Hazard – Repeated Melting Plastic and Toxic Fumes ] || ---------------- || I am extremely concerned about the safety and reliability of the GE GDT650SYV0FS dishwasher. This unit has experienced two separate and dangerous failures due to what I believe is a manufacturing defect involving the lower rack rollers.During both incidents, a roller broke off mid-cycle and melted onto the heating element, filling the apartment with toxic plastic fumes. The first time, it took over six months for a replacement part through a third-party repair vendor. Just a few months later, a different roller failed the same way, again melting and releasing toxic fumes. In both cases, the tenant—who was home at the time—had to shut the unit off manually to stop the cycle. Had no one been present, this could have easily escalated into a fire hazard.This isn't a cosmetic issue or a one-time defect—it's a serious recurring safety failure that has now happened twice under normal use.While the product was previously serviced under warranty, the recurrence suggests this is not an isolated issue, but rather a systemic design or materials flaw in the roller system. This kind of repeated failure should not occur with a modern appliance and certainly not one that markets itself as a premium, reliable product.I have contacted GE to formally request a refund or replacement with a safer, comparable model. Until this matter is resolved, I cannot in good conscience recommend this model to anyone. If safety and durability are priorities for you, I would advise looking elsewhere.

The first time, it took over six months for a replacement part through a third-party repair vendor. Just a few months later, a different roller failed the same way, again melting and releasing toxic fumes. In both cases, the tenant—who was home at the time—had to shut the unit off manually to stop the cycle. This kind of repeated failure should not occur with a modern appliance and certainly not one that markets itself as a premium, reliable product.I have contacted GE to formally request a refund or replacement with a safer, comparable model. Until this matter is resolved, I cannot in good conscience recommend this model to anyone. If safety and durability are priorities for you, I would advise looking elsewhere.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher about a month ago, and I have mixed feelings.
Comments (English): [ Has both pros and cons, but I would buy again ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher about a month ago, and I have mixed feelings. I absolutely love the top rack, I had a two rack dishwasher previously, and had no idea how much space the third rack would save. It's cut down on how often I run the dishwasher by a load a week. That being said, this dishwasher also smells worse than my last one between washes, I think a larger family wouldn't have this issue because they'd be running it more frequently, but a one or two person household that only runs their dishwasher once a week or so would have the same problem. It's slightly noisier than I expected, some reviews say that adjusts after about two weeks, but I never noticed it change. I wish I would have done more research on the prodry before buying, I'm not sure that it would have changed my purchase, but it would've been good to know up front. The fan on the prodry setting can stay on for up to 8 hours after running, I had gotten into the habit of starting my dishwasher before bed or as I left for work, but I can't do that with this dishwasher as it will use more electricity to keep the fan on for 8 hours. I've done some research, and other reviewers have said that the fan even kicks in if you don't use the pro dry option. The fan is also the part that seems to add to the noise factor, it's kind of an annoying buzzing sound that goes on/off during the wash cycle, and stays on during the drying cycle- I started running at night so I wouldn't have to listen to it while sitting in my living room. While that was frustrating to find out after I purchased it, it brings me to two of the benefits of this dishwasher. I love the hourly delay option, I've started timing it to start at 5am, so it finishes right around when I wake up- that way the fan isn't going on for hours. A lot of the dishwashers I looked into purchasing had delay options but only in 2 or 4 hour increments. Also, the benefit to the pro dry- is that my dishes are actually dry when it's done- sure I might have a small amount of water that pools on top of a divot in a cup- but I previously needed to use a towel to dry dishes after it ran, and my parents have to do the same with their newer Bosch. I do really like this dishwasher so far, hopefully this helps others get a better look at the pros vs cons without having to find out by trial like I did. Hoping this dishwasher is built to last, because that's the most important factor, especially for the cost.

It’s slightly noisier than I expected, some reviews say that adjusts after about two weeks, but I never noticed it change. I wish I would have done more research on the prodry before buying, I’m not sure that it would have changed my purchase, but it would’ve been good to know up front. The fan on the prodry setting can stay on for up to 8 hours after running, I had gotten into the habit of starting my dishwasher before bed or as I left for work, but I can’t do that with this dishwasher as it will use more electricity to keep the fan on for 8 hours. I’ve done some research, and other reviewers have said that the fan even kicks in if you don’t use the pro dry option. The fan is also the part that seems to add to the noise factor, it’s kind of an annoying buzzing sound that goes on/off during the wash cycle, and stays on during the drying cycle- I started running at night so I wouldn’t have to listen to it while sitting in my living room. While that was frustrating to find out after I purchased it, it brings me to two of the benefits of this dishwasher. I love the hourly delay option, I’ve started timing it to start at 5am, so it finishes right around when I wake up- that way the fan isn’t going on for hours. A lot of the dishwashers I looked into purchasing had delay options but only in 2 or 4 hour increments. Also, the benefit to the pro dry- is that my dishes are actually dry when it’s done- sure I might have a small amount of water that pools on top of a divot in a cup- but I previously needed to use a towel to dry dishes after it ran, and my parents have to do the same with their newer Bosch. I do really like this dishwasher so far, hopefully this helps others get a better look at the pros vs cons without having to find out by trial like I did. Hoping this dishwasher is built to last, because that’s the most important factor, especially for the cost.

Comments (English): [ If you operate like this, buying from a big company is the answer. ] || ---------------- || The installation was a total mess. What's the point of it being thin once it's installed? There's a 7cm gap. When I spoke to the technician over the phone, he said they had to install it like that to avoid defects and that other houses get installed like that too. He claimed that using the included connecting bridge would cause defects. So I asked, "Then there's that bridge that bends at the starting point, right?" He replied that if such a thing existed, they wouldn't have installed it like this. He spoke as if such a part doesn't even exist. My parents told them to connect it properly from under the sink. They said using the middle straight bridge causes defects, so why did they try to use the middle T-shaped bridge? Are they crazy? They even left without installing the two suction cups on the bottom. The manual clearly states that you must install them for safety. Coupang, whether you are a mediator or not, if you want to sell dishwashers properly, please be faithful to your basic service first. Samsung didn't have it, and while an LG model was being sold on Gmarket, when I clicked to buy it, it was out of stock. Checking the Q&A section, it said it had been discontinued. Comments (English): [ It's a must-have item! ] || ---------------- || When I was initially debating whether or not to buy this model, I compared it a lot with similar products that feature hot air drying. However, after actually using it, I found that even without the hot air, if I leave the door slightly open after washing, the residual heat releases moisture well and dries the dishes nicely. Personally, I am quite satisfied with it. When it was delivered, I noticed it was bigger than I expected. But it fit perfectly next to the water purifier. Our kitchen sink is low, so we couldn't install the dishwasher underneath it. I was worried it might feel cramped, but surprisingly, it fit right next to the sink after installation. The installation technician was also wonderful. He arrived right on time for the appointment, and he carefully checked and adjusted the leveling for each side one by one; I felt grateful for his dedication. He also kindly explained everything after installation, so even as a first-time user, I was able to get started without any difficulty. The controls are simpler than I thought. And the design goes without saying; it is the epitome of white cleanliness. Above all, the washing performance! When I ran it for the first time, the dishes were covered in grease... Seeing how the dishes squeaked clean, I thought I should have bought this sooner. The cups came out spotless too, so I was very satisfied. These days, I don't have to worry about washing dishes. I can leisurely enjoy a cup of tea after a meal, so I feel like this one item has brought a sense of ease to my daily life. I am using it so well that I regret the time I spent hesitating! ^^

Sentence (English): I used to use a 6-person dishwasher from another brand, but I bought an LG 14-person dishwasher to raise my soon-to-be-born babies.

In fact, even after washing and loading the dishwasher, grease stains often remained. ] || ---------------- || I used to use a 6-person dishwasher from another brand, but I bought an LG 14-person dishwasher to raise my soon-to-be-born babies. In fact, even after washing and loading the dishwasher, grease often remained, so I didn't use it often and just washed the grease separately by hand. However, I heard from many people around me that the LG 14-person dishwasher rarely had that problem even after using it for a long time, so I bought an LG one this time to make it easier to wash baby bottles. I haven't washed the bottles yet because the babies haven't been born yet, but after using it for a week, the grease I was worried about was completely resolved! Maybe because it has a 100-degree steam function, even hard grease like hardened peanut butter was completely removed. Also, when I wash dishes by hand, some days I have to scrub harder, and other days I use warm water because of the grease, but the LG dishwasher has a function that allows me to download various courses on my smartphone and use them in a customized way, so I can focus on the parts I need to clean, which was convenient. There are only two people, so there aren't many dishes, so I don't have to worry about Tetris, and I'm using it comfortably and very satisfactorily. When I was buying new home appliances, I didn't buy one because I thought it was too big for two people, but as expected, home appliances are a big win-win. Buying a 14-person model from the beginning was the way to make money. I had a big worry about installing a 14-person model in a rented house, but unlike other brands, there was a separate model for a 15cm mop holder, so I installed it well without damaging anything. I bought just one 10,000 won channel, and the technician installed it so that it could be restored to its original condition. On the contrary, when installing a 6-person model, I had to drill a hole in the top, so it was difficult to get permission from the landlord. The technician came and kindly explained the installation process step by step, and since I was pregnant, he gave me a lot of compliments, so it was a comfortable installation visit. Now that I think about it, I think I made a very good purchase. There's nothing to find fault with. I hope that even after a month or a year, I'll be this satisfied dishwasher aunt without any problems~

We purchased a new fridge and a new oven at the same time. The fridge is a GE - that's its own set of headaches. The oven is a popular stand mixer brand and has had absolutely NO issues whatsoever. We will be purchasing that brand from now on.

Comments (English): [ Very satisfied! The quality of my kitchen has improved. ] || ---------------- || I recently moved and purchased an LG dishwasher, and I'm so happy with it that I'm wondering why I waited so long to buy it. The clean design, powerful cleaning power, and quiet operation all exceeded my expectations. Design & Installation: The modern, luxurious beige color has given my kitchen a much more sophisticated feel. While it can be installed standing, we opted for a built-in option to better match our interior. The installer was very friendly and helpful. Cleaning Performance: Thanks to TrueSteam technology, glasses sparkle without any water stains. Even frying pans and pots, which I usually struggle to clean, were cleaned with utmost care. Thanks to the Tornado Washing Blade, even crevices and deep dishes are cleaned without residue. With TrueSteam, sterilization, and hot air drying, I can even handle baby bottles and food with confidence. This is the most satisfying part! Storage: The flexible internal basket layout allows for efficient storage of various utensils, including plates, cups, and pots. The middle basket can be moved up and down, allowing for easy storage of large pots at the very bottom. I especially appreciate the ability to separate the top and bottom for washing, saving water and electricity when only half-used. Noise & Convenience: The dishwasher is incredibly quiet, so I can use it even at night without any problems. The kids' bedroom is right next to the kitchen, and I can use it every evening without any problems. It's also Wi-Fi-enabled and can be remotely controlled and monitored via the LG ThinQ app. It also receives a notification on my smartphone when the dishwasher is done, which is incredibly convenient. I'm also very satisfied with the post-wash drying function. The high-temperature drying ensures a dry, odor-free finish, and the auto-open door keeps moisture out, ensuring hygienic safety. Comments (English): [ Intuitive, cleans really well ] || ---------------- || I've been using this dishwasher for a few months now. Starting off with the packaging; it was really well packed and padded which is important to me. All sides were covered and all the faces had plastic wrap. The inside was the same.The dishwasher itself is very sleek. I didn't have any issues getting it installed in replace of my old dishwasher either. Pros: plenty of space for every type of dish. The new and improved top tray is great. It has the normal remove able tray that you can put utensils in and it also has an area that dips in so you can fit bigger things like ladles or measuring cups. There's even a way to adjust the tray to accommodate wine glasses so they don't jiggle around. The middle drawer still adjusts up and down so accommodate taller glasses or taller pans from the bottom.There are a a bunch of options for running the machine but I love that you can connect it to your phone so you know when the cycle is complete. It tells you when to refill the liquid reservoir as well as when to run the self clean. The new AI feature runs the wash and can sense when it is clean or if it needs to keep going and that has been a game changer. The other features that make it worth it is that they're an option for plastic. So, your Tupperware, meal prep containers, dishes. It also has a setting for baby bottles so it can clean and steam sanitize it which eliminates the need for a separate appliance.You have all of your standard settings for quick wash, heavy duty, pots and pans. It does a really great job cleaning the actual dishes. I don't always wash my dishes immediately, so they have food stuck on them. It still does a great job getting them clean and I don't have issues with water spots.Cons: The only con I have is the adjustable drawer. It's either too high or too low. If I want tall glasses then I can't put in bigger pans and vice versa.

Sentence (English): I have purchased two Bosch dishwashers based on reviews.
Comments (English): [ Superb ly disappointed ] || ---------------- || I have purchased two Bosch dishwashers based on reviews. I had to replace the first after a few years when the handle-integrated control panel completely fell apart. The second, which have had for 13 months and which I chose for its more integrated panel configuration and the hope it would live up to reviews, has been a disaster from the start. It arrived with water in the hoses and every few washes it dies and requires multiple resets at the breaker before randomly reanimating. 5+ tech visits and replacing the control board once did not fix the problem and yet we still can't get a replacement from Bosch. Quiet operation? Yes! And customer service team has been personable if not empowered. But I will never buy this brand again and recommend you ask your repair provider for recs before you do so.

Sentence (English): I have owned a Bosch dishwasher for at least 10 years in my life.
Comments (English): [ Can't go wrong ] || ---------------- || I have owned a Bosch dishwasher for at least 10 years in my life. Previously, I owned either a 600 or an 800 series which was magnificent. Scraped the loose food off and put the dishes and silverware right in the dishwasher. I often left the dishes sit in the dishwasher for five days before running, and they all came out perfectly clean and if I left them in there long enough everything other than the top of my coffee cups was dry and spot free. I currently purchased a 100 series dishwasher because I was not using my previous dishwasher very much. I tried the 100 series Bosch exactly the way I used my previous one just scraping loose food off, putting the dishes and silverware right in and letting them sit in there for five days. I ran the dishwasher and could hardly hear that it was running And all the dishes came out perfectly clean and then I learned if I left the door closed long enough the dishes were spot, free and dry except for the top of cups. The 100 series definitely has some design flaws. The racks are so close together. It is hard to put balls or larger jars or anything other than a plate in the lower rack. The rack also drops if you're not careful because of the gap at the end of the dishwasher before the door. Additionally, the silverware container holes are not big enough for my knives to fit through and I have to pull up the entire separator top. All that being said, I could've paid more money, but I do Love my 100 series Bosch dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I was planning to buy a built-in dishwasher, but since it didn't fit in my cabinet, I was looking into a 6-place setting model.
Comments (English): [ Very satisfied with the value for money ] || ---------------- || I was planning to buy a built-in dishwasher, but since it didn't fit in my cabinet, I was looking into a 6-place setting model. I had considered this product from the beginning, but my family wanted a different brand, so I actually ended up buying a different one. However, I had to cancel the order because they refused installation, claiming the cabinet was just 1cm too short. They told me that even though it was technically fine, it wasn't allowed according to their guidelines. So, I purchased this product that I originally had in mind, and it fits perfectly, so I have been using it without any issues. First, let me list the advantages: 1. Clean design. Both the color and design are free of clutter, making it aesthetically pleasing. The glossy, glass-like material looks refreshing, so even though it is larger than I expected, it doesn't feel cramped. 2. Simple and intuitive. I wanted intuitive and simple functions without many complex features, and this product fits that description. There are four cycles, but there isn't a significant difference between them, so I think using the standard one will suffice. It is touch-operable and has a lock function, so I don't have to worry about my child accidentally touching and operating it. 3. Spacious. Honestly, I was worried that a 6-place setting might not hold much and would be awkward to use, making it feel like a useless item. However, the interior is surprisingly spacious, allowing me to pack dishes loosely. Of course, this is based on a single meal for a family of four! Since it runs for 65 minutes per cycle, I can run it without any pressure. 4. Automatic door opening. Honestly, the door opening might seem like a minor detail, but it was an important point for me. I don't want to constantly worry about it after running the dishwasher; the fact that the door opens automatically to dry the dishes even if I run it overnight is a huge advantage. 5. Value for money. Considering its performance and contribution to household chores, I think it offers excellent value for money. These are the advantages that come to mind. If I had to pick a disadvantage... 1. Noise. It isn't loud enough to be bothersome, but naturally, there is some noise. It might be noticeable when using it for the first time, but you get used to it quickly. 2. Space consumption. This is a disadvantage of freestanding dishwashers in general, rather than just this specific product. Since it takes up some space in the kitchen, there is the inconvenience of having to give up space you used to use. However, the satisfaction I get from this far outweighs the inconvenience.

Comments (English): [ Very satisfied with the value for money ] || ---------------- || I was planning to buy a built-in dishwasher, but since it didn't fit in my cabinet, I was looking into a 6-place setting model. I had considered this product from the beginning, but my family wanted a different brand, so I actually ended up buying a different one. However, I had to cancel the order because they refused installation, claiming the cabinet was just 1cm too short. They told me that even though it was technically fine, it wasn't allowed according to their guidelines. So, I purchased this product that I originally had in mind, and it fits perfectly, so I have been using it without any issues. First, let me list the advantages: 1. Clean design. Both the color and design are free of clutter, making it aesthetically pleasing. The glossy, glass-like material looks refreshing, so even though it is larger than I expected, it doesn't feel cramped. 2. Simple and intuitive. I wanted intuitive and simple functions without many complex features, and this product fits that description. There are four cycles, but there isn't a significant difference between them, so I think using the standard one will suffice. It is touch-operable and has a lock function, so I don't have to worry about my child accidentally touching and operating it. 3. Spacious. Honestly, I was worried that a 6-place setting might not hold much and would be awkward to use, making it feel like a useless item. However, the interior is surprisingly spacious, allowing me to pack dishes loosely. Of course, this is based on a single meal for a family of four! Since it runs for 65 minutes per cycle, I can run it without any pressure. 4. Automatic door opening. Honestly, the door opening might seem like a minor detail, but it was an important point for me. I don't want to constantly worry about it after running the dishwasher; the fact that the door opens automatically to dry the dishes even if I run it overnight is a huge advantage. 5. Value for money. Considering its performance and contribution to household chores, I think it offers excellent value for money. These are the advantages that come to mind. If I had to pick a disadvantage... 1. Noise. It isn't loud enough to be bothersome, but naturally, there is some noise. It might be noticeable when using it for the first time, but you get used to it quickly. 2. Space consumption. This is a disadvantage of freestanding dishwashers in general, rather than just this specific product. Since it takes up some space in the kitchen, there is the inconvenience of having to give up space you used to use. However, the satisfaction I get from this far outweighs the inconvenience.

Comments (English): [ Very satisfied with the value for money ] || ---------------- || I was planning to buy a built-in dishwasher, but since it didn't fit in my cabinet, I was looking into a 6-place setting model. I had considered this product from the beginning, but my family wanted a different brand, so I actually ended up buying a different one. However, I had to cancel the order because they refused installation, claiming the cabinet was just 1cm too short. They told me that even though it was technically fine, it wasn't allowed according to their guidelines. So, I purchased this product that I originally had in mind, and it fits perfectly, so I have been using it without any issues. First, let me list the advantages: 1. Clean design. Both the color and design are free of clutter, making it aesthetically pleasing. The glossy, glass-like material looks refreshing, so even though it is larger than I expected, it doesn't feel cramped. 2. Simple and intuitive. I wanted intuitive and simple functions without many complex features, and this product fits that description. There are four cycles, but there isn't a significant difference between them, so I think using the standard one will suffice. It is touch-operable and has a lock function, so I don't have to worry about my child accidentally touching and operating it. 3. Spacious. Honestly, I was worried that a 6-place setting might not hold much and would be awkward to use, making it feel like a useless item. However, the interior is surprisingly spacious, allowing me to pack dishes loosely. Of course, this is based on a single meal for a family of four! Since it runs for 65 minutes per cycle, I can run it without any pressure. 4. Automatic door opening. Honestly, the door opening might seem like a minor detail, but it was an important point for me. I don't want to constantly worry about it after running the dishwasher; the fact that the door opens automatically to dry the dishes even if I run it overnight is a huge advantage. 5. Value for money. Considering its performance and contribution to household chores, I think it offers excellent value for money. These are the advantages that come to mind. If I had to pick a disadvantage... 1. Noise. It isn't loud enough to be bothersome, but naturally, there is some noise. It might be noticeable when using it for the first time, but you get used to it quickly. 2. Space consumption. This is a disadvantage of freestanding dishwashers in general, rather than just this specific product. Since it takes up some space in the kitchen, there is the inconvenience of having to give up space you used to use. However, the satisfaction I get from this far outweighs the inconvenience.

I had considered this product from the beginning, but my family wanted a different brand, so I actually ended up buying a different one. However, I had to cancel the order because they refused installation, claiming the cabinet was just 1cm too short. They told me that even though it was technically fine, it wasn't allowed according to their guidelines. So, I purchased this product that I originally had in mind, and it fits perfectly, so I have been using it without any issues. First, let me list the advantages: 1. Clean design. Both the color and design are free of clutter, making it aesthetically pleasing. The glossy, glass-like material looks refreshing, so even though it is larger than I expected, it doesn't feel cramped. 2. Simple and intuitive. I wanted intuitive and simple functions without many complex features, and this product fits that description. There are four cycles, but there isn't a significant difference between them, so I think using the standard one will suffice. It is touch-operable and has a lock function, so I don't have to worry about my child accidentally touching and operating it. 3. Spacious. Honestly, I was worried that a 6-place setting might not hold much and would be awkward to use, making it feel like a useless item. However, the interior is surprisingly spacious, allowing me to pack dishes loosely. Of course, this is based on a single meal for a family of four! Since it runs for 65 minutes per cycle, I can run it without any pressure. 4. Automatic door opening. Honestly, the door opening might seem like a minor detail, but it was an important point for me. I don't want to constantly worry about it after running the dishwasher; the fact that the door opens automatically to dry the dishes even if I run it overnight is a huge advantage. 5. Value for money. Considering its performance and contribution to household chores, I think it offers excellent value for money. These are the advantages that come to mind. If I had to pick a disadvantage... 1. Noise. It isn't loud enough to be bothersome, but naturally, there is some noise. It might be noticeable when using it for the first time, but you get used to it quickly. 2. Space consumption. This is a disadvantage of freestanding dishwashers in general, rather than just this specific product. Since it takes up some space in the kitchen, there is the inconvenience of having to give up space you used to use. However, the satisfaction I get from this far outweighs the inconvenience.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 매우 만족 ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기를 빌트인으로 구매하려다가 장에 맞지 않아서 6인용으로 알아보던 중이었어요.저는 처음부터 이 제품을 고려했었는데 가족들이 다른 브랜드 상품을 원해서 사실 다른 제품을 구매했었어요.그런데 장이 1cm 부족하다는 이유로 설치 거부를 당해 취소를 했습니다. 실질적으로 괜찮아도 지침 상 안된다고 하더라고요.그래서 처음 생각했던 이 제품으로 구매를 했는데 아주 딱 맞아서 문제 없이 잘 사용하고 있습니다.우선 장점을 꼽자면 1. 디자인이 깔끔함.색상도 디자인도 군더더기가 없어 미관상으로 만족스럽습니다. 반질반질한 유리같은 재질로 시원해보여서 생각보다 크기가 큰데도 답답한 느낌이 없어요.2. 단순하고 직관적임. 여러 복잡한 기능 없이 직관적이고 단순한 기능을 원했는데 이 제품이 그랬어요. 코스도 4가지인데 큰 차이는 없어 일반으로 사용하면 될 것 같아요. 터치 작동도 되고, 잠금도 있어 아이가 만져서 조작할 염려도 없어요. 3. 넉넉함. 사실 6인용이면 얼마 들어가지도 않고 사용하기 애매해서 계륵같은 존재가 될까봐 걱정했는데 생각외로 내부가 넉넉해서 그릇을 듬성듬성 넣을 수 있어요. 물론 4인가족 한끼 식사 기준입니다! 한 번 사용할 때마다 65분이라 부담없이 돌려요.4. 자동 문열림. 사실 문 열리는게 별거 아닌 것 같아도 저에게는 중요한 포인트였어요. 식세기 돌리고나서 계속 신경쓰고 싶지 않고, 밤에 돌리고 자도 알아서 문이 열려 건조될 수 있는게 큰 장점인 것 같아요. 5. 가성비. 성능, 살림 기여도를 생각했을 때 매우 가성비가 뛰어나다고 생각합니다. 이 정도 장점이 생각나고, 단점을 꼽자면 1. 소음.거슬릴 정도의 소음은 아니지만 당연히 소음이 있어요. 처음 사용할 때 신경쓰일 수 있지만 금방 적응되긴 해요.2. 자리차지.이건 이 제품의 단점이라기보다 스탠드형 식세기의 단점이예요. 주방의 일부 공간을 차지하기 때문에 그동안 사용하던 공간을 내어줘야 하는 불편함이 있어요. 그래도 만족감이 훨씬 더 큽니다.

Sentence (English): I've been using this dishwasher for a few months now.
Comments (English): [ Intuitive, cleans really well ] || ---------------- || I've been using this dishwasher for a few months now. Starting off with the packaging; it was really well packed and padded which is important to me. All sides were covered and all the faces had plastic wrap. The inside was the same. The dishwasher itself is very sleek. I didn't have any issues getting it installed in replace of my old dishwasher either. Pros: plenty of space for every type of dish. The new and improved top tray is great. It has the normal remove able tray that you can put utensils in and it also has an area that dips in so you can fit bigger things like ladles or measuring cups. There's even a way to adjust the tray to accommodate wine glasses so they don't jiggle around. The middle drawer still adjusts up and down so accommodate taller glasses or taller pans from the bottom. There are a a bunch of options for running the machine but I love that you can connect it to your phone so you know when the cycle is complete. It tells you when to refill the liquid reservoir as well as when to run the self clean. The new AI feature runs the wash and can sense when it is clean or if it needs to keep going and that has been a game changer. The other features that make it worth it is that they're an option for plastic. So, your Tupperware, meal prep containers, dishes. It also has a setting for baby bottles so it can clean and steam sanitize it which eliminates the need for a separate appliance. You have all of your standard settings for quick wash, heavy duty, pots and pans. It does a really great job cleaning the actual dishes. I don't always wash my dishes immediately, so they have food stuck on them. It still does a great job getting them clean and I don't have issues with water spots. Cons: The only con I have is the adjustable drawer. It's either too high or too low. If I want tall glasses then I can't put in bigger pans and vice versa.

Comments (English): [ Highly recommend this dishwasher as it has a large ] || ---------------- || Maytag Washer Review for Model #MDPS7024SZ0. I really like my new Maytag dishwasher as it's such an upgrade over my previous dishwasher that was 10+ years old. It has a nice looking brushed stainless steel exterior and has a ton of cycles and really useful features. 5 Cycles: Powerblast for hard to clean items; Auto (senses how dirty dishes & pots are and selects optimal cycle); Normal for everyday use; Quick; and Rapid Sani, which sanitizes dishes. Wash Options: High Temperature; Air Dry, whereby the door automatically opens to air dry; Power Dry Short using heat; Power Dry Long/Max dries for a longer time and Delay which allows you to start the wash at a later time. Time: The cycle times range from about 4 hours for the Powerblast to 1:55 minutes for the Quick cycle. Note that select Power dry options increase the wash time by about 20 minutes for additional drying time. Pros: . - I love the large capacity with 3 racks that holds 2-3 days of dishes for my family. - Stainless steel interior which will be more durable than plastic. - Very Quiet. It's rated at 47 decibels and I barely hear it running. - Convenient features including. o Adjustable middle rack that can be raised about an inch, which allows you to wash larger pots on the bottom rack. o the silverware racks on the bottom and top racks lift out which is convenient when adding and putting away silverware. o Power Blast and filtration which avoids having to scrub and pre-rinse pots and dishes. o Indicator light of how much is remaining. Con: . The only drawback is the top controls which are hard to read when the door is closed. However you can get around this by setting the cycle with the door open. Conclusion: I highly recommend this dishwasher as it has a large capacity and a lot of well thought out design features including leak detection (which I hope never gets triggered! ) which make it convenient to use.

The LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE5BGL1E is a product that is more satisfactory than expected. I wondered if it was right to buy it considering the performance of the dishwasher at my parents' house 20 years ago, but I heard that the performance is really good these days, so I bought it. They say that if you put it in with food in it, it can smell every time you open the dishwasher, so I rinse it with water for a few seconds and put the dishes in. Even if you eat Jjajangbap, the dishes are washed well, and even on the day you eat pork belly, the dishes are washed well without oil, so I am satisfied. You can flexibly place dishes of various sizes, such as pots and large plates, so it is highly space-efficient. Everything from everyday dishes to baby food containers and wine glasses are washed cleanly. There is almost no noise. Even while the dishwasher was running, it didn't interfere with conversations or TV watching in the living room or kitchen. I'm very satisfied because it's okay to run it at night. Sentence (English): We purchased a 300 series Bosch dishwasher after using a brand name American entry-level dishwasher for 7 years.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, functional and smart ] || ---------------- || We purchased a 300 series Bosch dishwasher after using a brand name American entry-level dishwasher for 7 years. I am going to say that if you cook at home often and have guests over dinner frequently, you'll appreciate this Bosch machine over the cheaper options. To start with, the top rack where you put your utensils saves you a valuable space from the bottom rack where you put your large bowls, pots and dishes. Additionally, the utensil rack cleans items really well. Different than the entry-level dishwashers, 300 series dishwasher has the adjustability feature for the second rack. You can adjust the height of the rach where you put your glasses, small bowls, and jars. This feature is very useful, especially when you wash wine glasses or large pots and dishes as you need more room above or below the second rack. What's crazy is that you can adjust the height of the rack either on the left or right of the rack or on both sides. For example, if you have a large pot on the left side of the bottom rack, you can move the second rack higher only on the left side and can still fit your wine glasses on the right side of the second rack. This is awesome! Finally, there are multiple folding pins on both the second and bottom racks. This allows you to adjust usage of the washing space. For example, I fold the pins to fit lots of small food containers from work. On the other hand, if we have guests over dinner and have lots of small bowls to wash, we unfold the pins and place the bowls in a tilted position to the second or bottom rack. In additional to the functional racks, 300 series dishwasher has smart features which allows you to turn on and off the machine on your phone and change setting of your machine on the app. The smart feautre gives you the flexibility if you have a busy life-style. Sometimes, we forget to turn on the machine before we leave home in the morning. It is not ideal to come home, turn on the machine and wait a few hours for the dirty dishes to be washed and dried while the dirty pots and dishes from the dinner sits in the sink. Or sometimes we have last-minute guests over dinner and we need to wash the dirty pots and dishes ASAP for the dinner. We can turn on the machine remotely and it saves the night. Finally, the machine works quietly. It becomes very beneficial when your kitchen is next to the living room. When you are watching a movie which has lots of dialogue, the quiet washing is very valuable. I reserve my right to evaluate the long term performance and the durability of the dishwasher, but we chose Bosch over other brands because of its reliability. I hope it will be.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher has improved my life ] || ---------------- || I am happy with my new Whirlpool dishwasher. After a lot of consideration I went with the Black colour as my kitchen cabinets are beige. I am not ready to completely renovate the kitchen cabinets but I was keen to install a dishwasher to free up my time to do other things. I have a small kitchen and the 60cm width dishwasher was able to be retrofitted by cutting out some cabinet and removing a door and cutting a door down in half. I have used the dishwasher on the rapid program which lasts for 33 minutes and the door pops open by itself at the end of the cycle and dries naturally. I find this works well. It is easy to operate. I only have to press 3 buttons to run the rapid wash program. It is nice and quiet while running the program. This is important to me as I have the kitchen close to my lounge room where I watch TV and I cannot hear the dishwasher. I like the cutlery tray on the top shelf. It washes my wine glasses and glass tumblers very well. I already find this Whirlpool dishwasher to be an asset when entertaining and it has increased my enjoyment of cooking. It was worth my time to get the plumber to install the extra tap under the sink and get the carpenter to cut the cabinets to make the space to install the dishwasher. I am really pleased. And it has a 5 year warranty which is excellent. I have written all this out as I would like the extra cutlery holder that you get as a bonus for writing the review. It only comes with a cutlery tray which works just fine.

I will share my thoughts on purchasing the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher. First of all, I now buy most of my home appliances from Coupang, and one of the reasons is that 'insurance subscription' is very convenient and useful. If you add about 1-2% of the product price, you can get insurance for up to 5 years, and the fact that you almost never have to worry about repair costs in case of a breakdown is a huge advantage from the perspective of the actual user. In addition, I am satisfied with Coupang's fast payment, refund, and customer service. The installation was done by LG Electronics, and I was impressed that the installer checked the length of the mop holder and the surrounding structure together and thought about the location. It is important to check the length of the bottom of the mop holder before installation, so I recommend that you measure it in advance. This product is the first dishwasher that my family has used, and at first I thought, 'Do I really need it? ', but after using it, I really understood why everyone uses it. It's like having an extra aunt. If you have a family of 3 or more, I felt that a 14-person product like this is a must. The joy of being freed from washing dishes is greater than you think. Another advantage is that if you request a 'mobile' type when installing, you can easily take it with you when you move. I actually have plans to move, so I installed it as a standalone product instead of a wall mount. There are more advantages, but I think it will be too long, so I will stop here. This is a review that I wrote myself after taking the time to write it. I hope it helps you with your purchase. If it was helpful, please click the like button so that it helps me too.

LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 식기세척기를 구매하면서 느낀 점을 공유합니다. 우선 저는 이제 대부분의 가전제품을 쿠팡에서 구매하는데, 그 이유 중 하나는 ‘보험 가입’이 매우 간편하고 유용하다는 점입니다. 제품가의 약 1~2% 정도 비용만 추가하면 5년까지 보험이 가능하고, 고장 발생 시 수리비 부담이 거의 없어지는 점은 실제 사용자의 입장에서 큰 장점이라 생각합니다. 더불어 쿠팡의 빠른 결제, 환불, 고객응대까지도 모두 만족스럽습니다.  설치는 LG전자 측에서 직접 오셔서 진행하셨고, 설치 기사님이 걸레받이 길이나 주변 구조 등 함께 체크하며 위치를 함께 고민해 주신 점이 인상 깊었습니다. 설치 전에는 걸레받이 하단 길이 확인이 중요하니, 꼭 사전 측정하시길 권장드립니다.  이 제품은 저희 가족이 처음 써보는 식기세척기인데, 처음에는 '과연 필요할까?' 싶었지만, 막상 써보니 정말 왜 다들 사용하는지 알겠더군요. 마치 이모님 한 분을 더 둔 느낌이랄까요. 3인 이상 가족이라면 이 정도 14인용 제품은 필수라고 느꼈습니다. 설거지에서 해방되는 기쁨은 생각보다 큽니다.  또 하나의 장점은, 설치 시 ‘이동식’ 형태로 요청하면 이사할 때도 어렵지 않게 가져갈 수 있다는 점입니다. 저는 실제로 이사 계획이 있어 이 점을 고려해 벽면 고정이 아닌 독립형으로 설치했습니다.  더 많은 장점이 있지만, 너무 길어질 것 같아 이만 줄입니다.  시간을 할애해 직접 작성한 리뷰입니다. 구매에 도움이 되셨으면 좋겠습니다. 도움이 되셨으면 좋아요 눌러주시면 제게도 도움이 됩니다.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher at Lowe's when they had an appliance sale.
Comments (English): [ Great, so far! ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher at Lowe's when they had an appliance sale. It was delivered and installed in 2 days. It has taken a few days to get used to loading it because it is quite different from our 15 year old LG dishwasher. We particularly like the third rack. It is useful for utensils that are too big for the utensil holder or for small items and container lids. I like being able to lay the container lids flat on the third rack. It is very quiet, so I like having the red light glow below so I know it is actually running! When we purchased this dishwasher we were not made aware that it was possible to connect it to our WiFi. I do not see any advantage to connecting it to an app so we are using it without WiFi. It works just fine without being connected to an app! But I do wish the salesperson had pointed that out because we would have purchased a different model if we had known. I am not at all interested in having so called "smart" appliances.

Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch 800 series.
Comments (English): [ Bosch and only Bosch for quiet in the kitchen ] || ---------------- || This is our second Bosch 800 series. Our first replaced a Whirlpool that had the top rack collapse and with replacement parts on a 6 month back order we got our first Bosch and loved it. Loved the quiet. Fast forward a few years and with a new home came a GE model. Now after 3 years the pump motor failed. I did not want to repair it, I wanted a Bosch! So glad we did. Simply put, the Bosch machines are so quiet when operating you really cannot tell unless you stand very still right next to it and hold your breath. Aside from being super duper quiet, the machine does a wonderful job of cleaning. We've run it several times now with various levels of dirty pans and dishes and all come out sparkling. You do need to load correctly and carefuly as the Bosch racks are a bit different in layout. I do love that you can adjust rack height on the upper rack. The top tier tray is handy as well for utensils and silverware. All in all, if you want a well built, super quiet, very efficient dishwasher, Bosch is the way to go. Oh and yes we both love the snappy magnetic door catch!

Sentence (English): My recent Bosch Dishwasher purchase has been a great choice.
Comments (English): [ LOVE MY BOSCH ] || ---------------- || My recent Bosch Dishwasher purchase has been a great choice. My daughter-in-law raved about hers (same model but a few years old with push buttons) which peaked my interest in Bosch. This DW is very quiet, cleans well, holds lots of dishes, and I really love the red floor light that shows the machine in running. It dries well except, of course, plastics will be somewhat wet. (This even happens on a machine with a heating element.) I really like there is no heating element to melt plastic that may have fallen to the bottom. The only thing I hate is that you cannot delay a cycle with the machine buttons. You must connect it to wi-fi and I refuse to connect to WIFI. Really? WIFI for a dishwasher? Come on Bosch! The model I purchased was not available in the store so I didn't know it now had “electronic” and not “push” buttons. If I did know, I would have seriously considered another brand. My 4 star rating is because delay start is only available on WIFI and push buttons are no longer available on this model. Overall, this dishwasher is a great choice minus the requirement to hookup to WIFI for delay start.

Sentence (English): Unfortunately, our expectations were not met, and that was a major disappointment.
Comments (English): [ Results did not meet expectations in a variety of areas. - would love to have our money back!  ] || ---------------- || Unfortunately, our expectations were not met, and that was a major disappointment. We replaced our Kitchen Aid dishwasher, which performed superbly (but I accidentally damaged it when trying to slide it out), with this LG model, which we saw at our local Home Depot. The sales rep spoke highly of it, and it is quite an attractive unit, so we went with her recommendation.Once we got everything connected, we soon came to realize that:1. Regardless of what dryer settings you set it to, the dishes do not get dry. For example, the extended dry option, when selected, really does nothing. Our previous Kitchen Aid unit dried everything superbly and there was no waiting around to dry them all. We normally run our dishwasher before we go to bed and then open it up in the morning to put the dishes away. With our previous Kitchen Aid model, selecting an extra dry option resulted in a load that was completely dry and ready to put away. Not so with this LG model. You will have to take quite a few things out and hand-dry them with a towel (especially all plastic containers) - bummer.2. The removable silverware utensil basket is a bit lacking, including the difficulty in trying to lift off the top flaps on the basket. Now again, I am comparing this to the silverware basket in our previous Kitchen Aid, which had a variety of slots for different-sized eating and cooking utensils. These top lids are secured so tightly that if you need to raise them, whether to put larger items into those open spots or remove them, is not an easy task. In addition, all the silverware openings are the same size. There are no larger openings to include larger items. We are now in the process of looking for a good after-market silverware basket to replace this one.3. The two pull-out trays have angled prongs instead of them being straight up. The many prongs used to slide a glass on or other cooking items, like dishes or plastic containers, are angled. With prior dishwashers, they were pointed straight up, and as a result, you could put more items in those areas. Not so with this LG model. So after you've inserted various items into the dishwasher, it angles things like plates, causing them to touch in areas where water may not be able to clean effectively. So what you wind up doing is just inserting a plate in every other slot to allow for room in between, thus limiting the amount of items you can put in the dishwasher.Are there any good things about this LG dishwasher? Why yes. 1. It's an attractive-looking unit.2. It's very quiet - you don't even notice that it's on.3. Has a steam function (but couldn't tell you if that works or not).4. Does a great job of cleaning everything you put in the dishwasher.So, if we had it to do all over again, I would not purchase this model and would do my research further on other models. As a reminder, never order a unit from seeing it on the internet. Visit the store and research there, looking at the trays, the silverware basket, and so much more. Then you won't make the mistake that I did.In addition, visually inspect any display models and don't take the sales rep's recommendation on what model to purchase.We're very unhappy with this purchase, but what can I do? We had it installed by a plumber because we had a new kitchen put in. Oh well, it is what it is. but I sure do wish I had that $808 back.

First of all, I now buy most of my appliances on Coupang, and one of the reasons is the convenience and usefulness of their "insurance." Comments (English): [ Cleans Great which is all that really matters ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) We bought this dishwasher a month ago. My only complaint is that the layout of the 3 tiers and the prongs and space between them doesn't allow for great positioning of odd shaped dishes to be washed. After a month, I still don't have a good system for loading the dishwasher. I am sure I will eventually figure it out.

The removable silverware utensil basket is a bit lacking, including the difficulty in trying to lift off the top flaps on the basket. These top lids are secured so tightly that if you need to raise them, whether to put larger items into those open spots or remove them, is not an easy task. In addition, all the silverware openings are the same size. There are no larger openings to include larger items. We are now in the process of looking for a good after-market silverware basket to replace this one. 3. The two pull-out trays have angled prongs instead of them being straight up. The many prongs used to slide a glass on or other cooking items, like dishes or plastic containers, are angled. With prior dishwashers, they were pointed straight up, and as a result, you could put more items in those areas. Not so with this LG model. So after you've inserted various items into the dishwasher, it angles things like plates, causing them to touch in areas where water may not be able to clean effectively. So what you wind up doing is just inserting a plate in every other slot to allow for room in between, thus limiting the amount of items you can put in the dishwasher. Are there any good things about this LG dishwasher? Why yes. 1. It's an attractive-looking unit. 2. It's very quiet - you don't even notice that it's on. 3. Has a steam function (but couldn't tell you if that works or not). 4. Does a great job of cleaning everything you put in the dishwasher. So, if we had it to do all over again, I would not purchase this model and would do my research further on other models. As a reminder, never order a unit from seeing it on the internet. Visit the store and research there, looking at the trays, the silverware basket, and so much more. Then you won't make the mistake that I did. In addition, visually inspect any display models and don't take the sales rep's recommendation on what model to purchase. We're very unhappy with this purchase, but what can I do? We had it installed by a plumber because we had a new kitchen put in. Oh well, it is what it is. but I sure do wish I had that $808 back.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is very nice and very sophisticated.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher May 2025 ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is very nice and very sophisticated. At first, we had a couple of issues getting it to connect to the network (why manufacturers do that to take advantage of all the features is beyond my understanding) but the customer service was outstanding! As for cleanliness, it works very well. We don't wash a bunch of plastic but what we do wash dries as expected. Some of our plastic cups have rims on the bottom that traps water but I can't imagine any dishwasher not doing that. The auto air feature, where irt pops open, is a really nice touch. We live in New Mexico so the dry air might help dry the dishes as well. We had a Frigidaire, but the hinge broke on the door, but it was quieter even though both dishwashers were rated the same noise level at 44 db. We live in New Mexico so the dry air might help dry the dishes as well. We had a Frigidaire, but the hinge broke on the door, but it was quieter even though both dishwashers were rated the same noise level at 44 db. It is quiet, but the fewer dishes the more noise against the door. More dishes make it quitter. In retrospect, I probably would recommend the 800 series instead as it is quieter and has even better drying, through drying seems to be just fine. Time will tell.

Sentence (English): My wife and I are long empty-nesters.
Comments (English): [ Broke after three times ] || ---------------- || My wife and I are long empty-nesters. We haven't had kids at home since 2012. When the last of our kids moved out, it has become very rare we ever use a dishwasher. It is just easier to wash our few dishes in the sink and air dry. On the rare occasions they are here or for holidays, we use a dishwasher. What was once a nightly thing became a once a month thing when using a dishwasher. When our old dishwasher of 10 years sprung a leak (and ruined our floors) we opted to buy this unit from Costco, along with a matching fridge. The fridge and dishwasher are compliments to our dual Kitchen Aid oven and microwave combo that we are thrilled with. The dishwasher was delivered and installed November 6th, 2024. The first time we used it was that night to try it out. Didn't use it again until Thanksgiving, and the next time was Christmas day. The 4th time we went to use it, in February for a daughter's birthday dinner, the dishwasher didn't fill with water. The dishwasher 'cycled through.' It went through the drying process. I am guessing it was because of the lack of water in the unit when drying, but all our plastic dishware melted. Bowls, cups, etc. Not only were our plastic dishes melted, but any other dish that had any dirt/food debris left, that stuff was baked on. I called for a warranty service, but it was a two week wait. I read somewhere on line that unplugging it for several minutes and plugging it back in might reboot it. This actually worked. I canceled the warranty service. Fast forward a couple of months, and we had a family get together over Memorial Day Weekend, and once again, the dishwasher didn't wash dishes. I tried to reboot it once again, but that didn't work. Tried once more, and still nothing. It seems like it fills with water this time, but it doesn't pump water through the jets. It will fill and drain. The dishes do not get washed. The drying process leaves a detergent film all over the dishes. I can honestly say, in the 6 months or so we've had, it hasn't worked more than it has. We have used it successfully, maybe 5 or 6 times. The warranty process from Costco is not actually great. Long service wait times and you have to jump through their script of trying to fix it yourself, as if you don't know how to operate a dishwasher. Once you get past the script, and do your in real-time trouble shooting with them over the phone, you have to agree to a potential $180 service charge in case the tech company comes and finds nothing wrong with it. My fear is, the tech will unplug it again, and it will work the next time, There is no question, this dishwasher is defective.
